text: 标普全球市场情报首席商业经济学家Chris Williamson表示：“9月份美国商业活动增速创五年多来最高水平，需求增长和企业信心改善推动企业以五年多来最快的速度扩大产出。结合表现同样稳健的制造业PMI，强劲的服务业扩张意味着，第三季度美国经济增长率将达到4%左右，9月份经济增长进一步加快，也预示着第四季度初经济增长动能正在增强。科技企业报告称，增长速度为近四年来最快，表明人工智能热潮正在提振大型科技企业。其他行业也受到鼓舞，面向消费者的企业以及医疗、酒类、房地产和金融服务等行业均报告增长加快。不过，人们担心经济运行过热的迹象正日益明显。企业投入成本受
text_en: Chris Williamson, Chief Business Economist at S&P Global Market Intelligence, said: "The pace of US business activity growth in September was the fastest in more than five years, with demand growth and improved business confidence driving firms to expand output at the fastest rate in more than five years. Combined with the similarly solid manufacturing PMI, the strong services expansion means that US economic growth in the third quarter will be around 4%, and the further acceleration of economic growth in September also signals that growth momentum is strengthening at the start of the fourth quarter. Tech firms reported the fastest growth in nearly four years, indicating that the AI boom is boosting large technology companies. Other industries were also encouraged, with consumer-facing firms as well as sectors such as healthcare, alcohol, real estate, and financial services all reporting faster growth.
